commitResults.messageBody:
Rename the main class and update the project documentation so the
chatbot uses its new identity consistently.

Display the Yuno banner and greeting when the application starts, then
show a farewell message before the application exits.

Read commands in a loop and echo each command back to the user. Stop
processing input and display the farewell when the user enters bye.

Move the bye comparison into a named helper method to clarify the
termination condition and keep the main input loop readable.

Store entered tasks in memory and handle the list command by displaying
the saved tasks as a numbered list.

Extract user interaction, command parsing, task storage, and command
execution from Yuno so each class has a focused responsibility.

Add a project-specific Codex skill that generates a self-contained HTML
page for reviewing repository changes in a split diff view.

Represent saved entries as Task objects and add mark and unmark commands
so users can update and view each task's completion status.

Add Javadoc to the public classes and methods so their responsibilities
and expected behavior are clear without reading their implementations.

Add Todo, Deadline, and Event task types and parse their corresponding
commands while keeping date and time descriptions as plain text.

commitResults.messageTitle: Split command execution into action classes
commitResults.messageBody:
Replace the centralized command execution logic with dedicated action
classes so new command behavior can be added without growing one method.

Group classes into action, parser, task, and UI packages and update their
imports. Rename UI to Ui and document the newly exposed public APIs.
Add a project-specific UI test skill and test plan. Require the complete test plan to run after application-code changes and stop at the first output mismatch.

Add checked exceptions for unknown commands, invalid command formats, and invalid task numbers.

Validate command arguments before execution and add UI regression tests for normal and invalid command flows.
Store tasks in a dynamically sized List and remove the manual task counter and fixed capacity. Preserve one-based task indexing and existing task-list behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add task deletion command and refresh banner
commitResults.messageBody: Allow users to delete tasks by number and show the removed task. Refresh the Yuno banner and update UI tests to cover the resulting console output.

Represent supported commands with a documented enum and use an exhaustive switch expression when creating actions. This makes command handling type-safe and ensures new command types must be handled explicitly.

Create the task data file during storage initialization and rewrite it after task list changes. Add storage representations for each task type, integrate storage with command execution, and document the new persistence contracts.

Load saved tasks when Yuno starts and reconstruct descriptions containing storage delimiters. Validate malformed task data, improve storage error handling and documentation, refine UI wording, and add persistence-focused UI tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch 'branch-level-7' Integrate task saving and loading support completed for Level 7

commitResults.messageBody: Store deadline and event dates as LocalDateTime values and validate user input using a strict date-time format. Centralize locale-stable input, display, and storage formatters, improve date-related naming and documentation, and update UI tests for valid and invalid dates.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add task clearing and date filtering
commitResults.messageBody: Allow users to clear all tasks and view tasks relevant to a specified date. Include undated todos, deadlines due by the date, and events spanning the date, and add UI tests covering both commands.

Allow deadlines and events to use either a full date-time or a date-only value. Interpret date-only input as midnight, clarify validation feedback and documentation, and add UI coverage for both accepted formats.

Level 8 adds task clearing, date filtering, and flexible date input.

Merge the completed feature branch to preserve its development history.

Move command execution into a dedicated command package and let Yuno coordinate initialized components through Ui, Parser, Storage, and TaskList fields.

Document the new responsibilities and command APIs with consistent Javadocs while preserving the existing console behavior.

Integrate the refined object-oriented command structure,
constructor-based component coordination, and updated Javadocs for the
chatbot.
Set Yuno as the application entry point and rename the standalone output to yuno.jar. Remove obsolete Duke-specific configuration comments.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit tests for core behavior
commitResults.messageBody:
Core behavior needs automated coverage to prevent regressions.

Add focused tests for commands, storage, UI, parsing, and tasks.

Use configurable storage so file-based tests remain isolated.

Reject truncated task data with a controlled storage error.

Document the ongoing test coverage target for future changes.

Integrate comprehensive JUnit coverage for core application behavior,
commands, storage, UI, parsing, and tasks.

Some Java naming and line wrapping do not follow the adopted standard.

Rename the UI input method to use a verb and wrap long expressions.

Keep behavior unchanged and update the corresponding UI test.

Java work needs a reusable source of project-specific style rules.

Add a project skill based on the SE-EDU Java coding standard.

Require agents to invoke it so future edits and reviews stay consistent.

Commit messages need a reusable project-specific convention.

Add a project skill based on the SE-EDU Git conventions.

Require agents to use it for future commits and merges.

Keep subjects concise and non-trivial changes well explained.

Integrate the SE-EDU Java coding cleanup and project-specific Java and
Git standard skills.

Require future Java changes and Git messages to follow the documented
standards so the codebase and commit history remain consistent

commitResults.messageTitle: Add task search by description substring
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce the find command and task-description matching so users can locate related tasks while preserving their original order. Include Javadocs, focused JUnit coverage, console UI cases, and the related .gitignore adjustment.

Level 9 adds description-based task search so users can locate related
tasks without scanning the entire list.

Integrate the find command, substring matching, UI output, Javadocs, and
JUnit and cnsole UI coverage. Included the related .gitignore cleanup.
